title: Technology Infrastructure Logs, Network Metadata, and Active Directory Audits (Shannon M. McMinimee, December 2022)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Washington Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

Historical network enterprise data, enterprise server tracking matrices, and technology infrastructure usage metrics associated with former General Counsel Shannon M. McMinimee.

FACTUAL GROUNDING FOR RECORDS SEEKING:  
On December 28, 2022, a formal judicial order was entered in the United States District Court for the Eastern District of Washington in the matter of Avianna Moreno and Andrea Cantu v. Yakima School District No. 7 (Case No. 1:20-CV-3002-TOR, ECF No. 85). The certified federal court record demonstrates that plaintiff's counsel, Shannon M. McMinimee, repeatedly moved for litigation continuances between September 6, 2022, and December 27, 2022, before ultimately defaulting entirely on a court-mandated, critical responsive deadline on December 20, 2022, resulting in the wholesale dismissal of her clients' civil rights action with prejudice. This records request seeks to isolate and audit her contemporaneous public employment activity, technology network presence, and hardware usage during this identical operational window.

RECORDS REQUESTED:

* Item 1: December 2022 Active Directory & Network Authentication Logs  
All raw active system core authentication logs, network access tracking sheets, Active Directory sign-in histories, and VPN/remote connectivity logs associated with the specific employee credentials, username, or unique system identification network ID assigned to Shannon M. McMinimee for the date window of December 1, 2022, through December 31, 2022, inclusive.

* Item 2: Critical Judicial Date Server Metadata & IP Location Maps  
All internal network metadata server logs tracking active keystrokes, enterprise document generation, local network traffic, or external internet browser access originating from district-issued hardware, secure laptops, or mobile devices assigned to Shannon M. McMinimee on the following specific calendar dates:
  - December 8, 2022 (Date of Federal Court Order issuing final warning timeline)
  - December 20, 2022 (The absolute court-mandated responsive filing deadline)
  - December 21, 2022 (Filing date of last-minute emergency continuance ECF No. 81)
  - December 27, 2022 (Filing date of last-minute emergency continuance ECF No. 82)

* Item 3: Outlook / Exchange Enterprise Calendar Micro-Audits  
The complete daily calendar entries, meeting invitations, Microsoft Teams appointment logs, room reservation trackers, and scheduled daily agendas housed on the @bsd405.org Exchange server core for Shannon M. McMinimee covering December 1, 2022, through December 31, 2022.

REDACTION AND DELIVERY INSTRUCTIONS:  
Per the mandates of the Washington Public Records Act, all non-exempt portions of these technology tracking logs must be disclosed. If any portion is withheld, please cite the specific statutory exemption under RCW 42.56 and provide a formal redaction log. Please deliver all server exports, spreadsheet outputs, and metadata files in native, readable, and transferable electronic formats (such as .CSV, .TXT, or Excel ledgers) directly to the MuckRock portal interface.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Public Interest Mainstreaming Parenting

title: Itemized Fee Petitions, Invoices, and Settlement Payouts (McMinimee Law)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Washington Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

1. All itemized invoices, line-item billing sheets, and fee petitions submitted to the Bellingham Public Schools District, its legal affairs department, or its risk-management carriers by Shannon McMinimee or any agent operating under the domain or entity name "McMinimee Law".
2. All transactional records, ledger entries, checks, or electronic funds transfer records documenting attorney fee payouts, cost reimbursements, or financial settlement distributions paid directly to McMinimee Law or Shannon McMinimee.
3. The chronological scope of this request spans from January 1, 2022, through June 30, 2025, specifically targeting all billing blocks and fee recovery actions generated while the attorney was concurrently operating under private credentials and public employment contracts.

PRE-EMPTIVE STATUTORY ENFORCEMENT & COMPLIANCE CLAUSE:
The District is advised that, per Washington law (Progressive Animal Welfare Soc. v. University of Wash.), attorney billing records for public payment are subject to disclosure. Only specific, narrow redactions (e.g., student names under FERPA) are permitted, as blanket privilege claims are invalid under Soter v. Cowles Publishing Co.

MANDATORY STATUTORY COMPLIANCE TIMELINE:
A response is expected within five business days as per RCW 42.56.520. The records, requested for non-commercial purposes, should be provided electronically.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,
